en.name: Breaded fish, frozen
en.summary: Frozen breaded fish keeps 18 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F). Keep it frozen and cook as directed — the coating is usually only part-fried, so the fish inside is raw or barely set. Refrigerating it after cooking is not recommended, because the coating goes soggy.
en.pantry: No room-temperature storage. Breaded fish is raw or part-cooked fish in a wet-then-fried coating, and once it warms it is in the danger zone of 4–60 °C (40–140 °F) like any other raw fish. Do not leave a box out to soften before cooking — the coating absorbs the melting ice and the whole thing fries greasy. The two-hour rule applies to anything left out, one hour above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: Refrigerating breaded fish after cooking is not recommended, because the quality drops so sharply: the coating draws moisture out of the fish and goes soft and pasty, and reheating never restores the crunch. No refrigerated timeline is given for that reason. Nor is there any advantage in thawing it in the fridge before cooking; the pack instructions assume it goes into the oven or pan frozen, and a thawed piece sheds its coating.
en.freezer: 18 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality — a long window because the fish is sealed inside a coating that shields it from the dry freezer air. That is a quality figure, not a safety limit: fish held continuously at −18 °C stays safe indefinitely. What to judge by is the product itself — dry white patches, a coating gone grey or grainy, heavy ice in the box. Keep the box flat and away from the freezer door.
en.thawing: Do not thaw. Cook from frozen exactly as the pack directs, and check the fish inside is opaque and flakes apart. Breaded fish thawed in the fridge and still at or below 4 °C (40 °F) may be refrozen with some quality loss; anything thawed on the counter or in warm water must not be refrozen.
spoilage: Dry white or grey patches where the coating has frost-burned.
Heavy ice inside the box, or pieces welded together — it part-thawed and refroze.
A strong fishy or ammonia smell on opening, which means it goes out.
Coating that falls off in sheets when cooked, a sign the pack thawed at some point.
tips: Buy it last and get it into the freezer fast; the cold chain is the whole game.
Cook from frozen — a thawed piece sheds its coating and fries greasy.
Spread the pieces out on the tray so they crisp rather than steam.
Cook only as many as you will eat; reheated breaded fish is never good.

faq.q: How long does frozen breaded fish last?
faq.a: 18 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe beyond that, but the coating dries and frost-burns.

faq.q: Do you need to thaw fish fingers before cooking?
faq.a: No. Cook them from frozen as the pack directs — a thawed piece loses its coating and cooks greasy.

faq.q: Can you keep cooked breaded fish in the fridge?
faq.a: It is not recommended, because the coating goes soggy and never crisps up again. Cook only what you will eat.

zh.name: 冷凍裹粉魚
zh.summary: 冷凍裹粉魚在 −18 °C 下自購買日起可放 18 個月。請保持冷凍，並依包裝指示加熱——外層通常只是半油炸過，裡面的魚肉還是生的或幾乎沒熟。煮好之後不建議改放冷藏，因為外皮會整個軟掉。
zh.pantry: 沒有室溫保存這一項。裹粉魚是生的或半熟的魚肉，外面裹著沾濕再炸過的麵衣，一回溫就和任何生魚一樣落在 4～60 °C 的危險溫度帶裡。不要為了好料理先把整盒放外面回軟——麵衣會把融出來的水吸進去，整個炸起來又油又爛。任何擺在外面的都適用兩小時原則，超過 32 °C 只有一小時。
zh.fridge: 煮好的裹粉魚不建議改放冷藏，因為品質掉得太快：麵衣會把魚肉裡的水吸出來，變得又軟又糊，而且再怎麼回熱都酥不回去。這裡不給冷藏期限，原因就在這裡。料理前也沒有必要先放冷藏解凍；包裝上的說明本來就假設它是冷凍進烤箱或下鍋的，而解凍過的魚排一下鍋麵衣就掉了。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下自購買日起 18 個月品質最好——期限之所以長，是因為魚肉被麵衣包在裡面，擋住了冷凍庫乾燥的空氣。那是品質數字，不是安全上限：全程維持在 −18 °C 的魚可以無限期保持安全。要判斷的是產品本身——乾白斑塊、麵衣變灰或變粗糙、盒子裡結了厚冰。請平放，並遠離冷凍櫃門。
zh.thawing: 不要解凍。照包裝指示從冷凍直接加熱，並確認裡面的魚肉已經變得不透明、可以剝成片。在冷藏解凍、而且始終維持在 4 °C 以下的可以再冷凍，只是品質打折；在檯面上或溫水裡解凍過的絕對不能再冷凍。
spoilage: 麵衣出現乾白或發灰的凍燒斑塊。
盒內結厚冰，或整盒黏成一塊——那表示它曾經半退冰又再凍。
打開時有濃重的魚腥味或氨味，那就該丟。
下鍋時麵衣整片剝落，代表它中途解凍過。
tips: 最後才拿冷凍品，回家馬上進冷凍；冷鏈就是一切。
從冷凍直接煮——解凍過的會掉麵衣、炸起來油膩。
在烤盤上把每片攤開排好，才會酥而不是被自己蒸軟。
吃多少煮多少；回熱過的裹粉魚沒有一次是好吃的。

faq.q: 冷凍裹粉魚可以放多久？
faq.a: −18 °C 下自購買日起 18 個月品質最好。只要沒退冰就一直安全，但麵衣會變乾、凍燒。

faq.q: 魚柳條要先退冰再煮嗎？
faq.a: 不用。照包裝指示從冷凍直接煮——解凍過的會掉麵衣，也會變得油膩。

faq.q: 煮好的裹粉魚可以冰冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 不建議，因為麵衣會軟掉而且再也酥不回來。吃多少煮多少。
